items.title: Bitcoin miner MARA raises $185 million in debt after selling $1 billion BTC to repay loans
items.summary: The bitcoin miner is taking on borrowing tied to an Ohio power plant as it shifts more of its business toward AI infrastructure.

items.title: Bullish beats revenue estimates as institutional services offset sluggish spot crypto volumes
items.summary: The crypto platform reported net income of $576.3 million for the third quarter thanks to a sharp rise in the price of bitcoin.

items.title: Circle turns to DBS as banks build rival digital payment systems across Asia
items.summary: The Singapore bank will let institutional clients buy and redeem USDC directly as banks across Asia develop their own blockchain payment systems.

items.title: Blaming Anthropic’s IPO for bitcoin’s slide is 'easy to believe,' but flawed, analysts say
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 18, 2026

items.title: Bitcoin drops as Nvidia earnings report drives stock index futures higher
items.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.1% since midnight UTC at around $64,100, failing to keep pace with rising stock index futures after Nvidia beat earnings.

items.title: Bitcoin outpaces gold even as both assets tumble ahead of a likely Fed rate hike
items.summary: Bitcoin held near $64,000 as gold fell 2%, lifting the ratio between the two above its 200-day moving average and extending a series of higher lows since March.

items.title: Strategy stock could plunge 76% to $23, chart analyst warns
items.summary: Aksel Kibar, who has tracked Bitcoin’s price action since at least 2018, made the bearish call, citing a still-active head-and-shoulders pattern on MicroStrategy’s (MSTR) daily chart.

items.title: Hyundai tests AI agent commerce on JPMorgan’s Kinexys blockchain
items.summary: The exploration of AI agents with JPMorgan builds on Hyundai’s recent stablecoin-based cross-border remittance pilot.

items.title: Google finds self-running AI hacking tool with Russian comments in its files
items.summary: Google spots an AI that can find and exploit software flaws on its own, no human needed.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slides towards $63,000 as U.S. stocks fall and Nvidia erases gains
items.summary: XRP edged toward $1, and SOL rose 3%, while a Talos report showed crypto’s favorite carry trade now pays about the same as U.S. Treasuries.

items.title: Bitcoin Covenants Part 6: FE Covenants — Enforcing covenants through cryptographically restricted signing keys
items.summary: FE covenants encode spending constraints into the signing key, so only transactions that satisfy a predefined condition can be signed.

items.title: CoinShares sells all treasury ETH, halves SOL holdings for buybacks
items.summary: The October sales raised $19.3 million, nearly half the $40 million CoinShares can spend on buybacks before its next annual meeting.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Sanctions fears loom over Russia’s regulated crypto trading launch
items.summary: Russia’s crypto trading rollout faces uncertainty as companies weigh sanctions exposure, while Moscow Exchange prepares to launch crypto trading in December.

items.title: How to preserve wealth and access funds during a national emergency
items.summary: As geopolitical and technological threats multiply, the big question is whether you can hold on to your wealth and access funds when the system fails.

items.title: Tokenized Nvidia market cap surges 159% amid Jensen Huang’s exit
items.summary: Nvidia stock tokens reached $401.9 million in combined value as Jensen Huang stepped down and the chipmaker posted record quarterly revenue.

items.title: Bitwise seeks Texas Stock Exchange listing for Zcash ETF
items.summary: Coinbase Custody would safeguard the fund’s ZEC holdings, while Bitwise Investment Advisers would serve as its manager and sponsor.

items.title: Bitcoin steadies after Nvidia’s earnings beat as $60K bids stand out
items.summary: Bitcoin halted downside as Nvidia confidence returned, with its stock gaining 3% premarket and South Korea’s tech-heavy KOSPI reclaiming 5,000 points.

items.title: World Bank partners with Circle, Citi to explore stablecoins for payments
items.summary: The initiative builds on the World Bank’s existing blockchain platform, which aims to create more fund traceability for investments in developing countries.

items.title: SOL comes out of Breakpoint 7% higher as Solana exits beta
items.summary: Solana’s token reached $75.12 on Tuesday, outpacing Bitcoin and Ether after the network retired the beta label it had used since its 2020 launch.

items.title: Movie2K Defendant Could Hand Over 40,000 Bitcoin to End Trial—and Stay a Billionaire
items.summary: A German judge has offered to drop the charges if the alleged operator of the piracy site gives up most of his remaining Bitcoin.

items.title: Morning Minute: Nvidia Beats, Board Says ‘No’ on Jensen
items.summary: Nvidia delivered its best earnings ever and raised forward guidance. And yet, the market mostly shrugged. What does it mean?

items.title: 'Doomed From the Start': President Trump's Meme Coin Hits New Lows After Midterms
items.summary: The TRUMP token has fallen almost 40% since election day, with analysts pointing to the Democrats’ subpoena plans, fading interest, and a heavy unlock schedule.

items.title: AI Will Make the Next 12 Months 'a Slaughterhouse' for Crypto Security: Anchorage Exec
items.summary: Security chiefs at Solana's Breakpoint said AI is lowering the bar for hackers, as North Korea steps up its attacks on crypto firms.

items.title: Scattered Spider Hacker Sentenced to 6 Years Over $11.6M in Stolen Crypto
items.summary: Scotland's Tyler Buchanan is the last of five defendants sentenced in a phishing and SIM-swapping scheme that targeted crypto holders.

items.title: Why Microsoft Thinks Smaller, Cheaper AI Can Beat Claude and GPT
items.summary: Microsoft's new coding, cybersecurity and image models challenge bigger rivals on performance and price. The company's bet is that doing one job exceptionally well matters more than doing absolutely everything.

items.title: Nvidia Board Shuts Down Jensen Huang Comeback, Launches Search for New CEO
items.summary: Nvidia's board rejected a comeback for its ousted co-founder as it hired a search firm, backed interim CEO Colette Kress, and tightened oversight of chip exports to China.

items.title: Nvidia Shares Rise After Earnings Beat in First Report Since Jensen Huang's Exit
items.summary: The chipmaker doubled quarterly revenue, forecast another record and rallied after hours, but its first report without Jensen Huang leaves leadership questions and a deeply bruised stock chart unresolved.

items.title: OpenAI's GPT 6.2 Astra Challenges Anthropic on Price, But Not Every Benchmark
items.summary: OpenAI's latest models promise better professional work for less money, as the company battles Anthropic and Google for AI supremacy and faces tougher questions about increasingly capable systems and safety.

items.title: World Bank Taps Circle and Citi to Test Stablecoins for Development Payments
items.summary: The institution will test whether Circle’s USDC and blockchain rails can speed up and cut the cost of disbursing development funds.
